stt_components.name: SpeechService Interface (STT)
stt_components.description: Speech-to-Text engine interface with states: UNINITIALIZED, IDLE, PREPARING, RECOGNIZING, PROCESSING, ERROR. Supports continuous mode, partial results, volume level monitoring, and language selection.

stt_components.name: SpeechServiceFactory (STT)
stt_components.description: Factory for STT service types: SHERPA_NCNN (local), OPENAI_STT, DEEPGRAM_STT. Uses reference-counted local service lease pattern.

stt_components.name: SherpaSpeechProvider (Local STT)
stt_components.description: Local STT via sherpa-ncnn JNI (com.k2fsa.sherpa.ncnn). Lightweight, mobile-optimized ASR engine. Uses ONNX Silero VAD for voice activity detection.

stt_components.name: SherpaMnnSpeechProvider (Local STT)
stt_components.description: Local STT via sherpa-mnn within the MNN framework. Alternative to sherpa-ncnn that uses MNN as the inference runtime.

stt_components.name: DeepgramSttProvider (Cloud STT)
stt_components.description: Cloud STT via Deepgram API. Records WAV audio with VAD-based auto-stop (Silero VAD via ONNX). Supports smart_format, punctuation, language selection. Integrates SpeechPrerollStore for pre-recording buffering.

stt_components.name: OpenAISttProvider (Cloud STT)
stt_components.description: Cloud STT via OpenAI Whisper API endpoint

stt_components.name: OnnxSileroVad
stt_components.description: ONNX Runtime implementation of Silero VAD for voice activity detection. Used by both STT providers and wake word listener for real-time speech detection.

stt_components.name: PersonalWakeListener (Custom Wake Word)
stt_components.description: Custom wake word detection via DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) similarity matching against enrolled templates. Configurable similarity thresholds, noise RMS estimation, dynamic thresholding, and VAD-based segmentation.

stt_components.name: PersonalWakeFeatureExtractor
stt_components.description: Extracts audio features from PCM samples for wake word template enrollment

stt_components.name: PersonalWakeEnrollment
stt_components.description: UI service for enrolling (recording) custom wake word templates

stt_components.name: SpeechPrerollStore
stt_components.description: Ring buffer that stores pre-recording audio so STT can capture speech that started before the user pressed the button

tts_components.name: VoiceService Interface (TTS)
tts_components.description: TTS interface with speak(), pause(), resume(), stop(), setVoice(). Supports rate/pitch override and extra provider-specific parameters.

tts_components.name: VoiceServiceFactory (TTS)
tts_components.description: Factory for TTS service types: SIMPLE_TTS, HTTP_TTS, OPENAI_WS_TTS, SILICONFLOW_TTS, MINIMAX_TTS, MIMO_TTS, DOUBAO_TTS, OPENAI_TTS, VITS_TTS

tts_components.name: OpenAIRealtimeVoiceProvider (TTS + Realtime)
tts_components.description: OpenAI Realtime WebSocket TTS with bidirectional audio streaming. Supports 10 voices (alloy, ash, ballad, cedar, coral, echo, marin, sage, shimmer, verse). 24kHz PCM output.

tts_components.name: HttpVoiceProvider (TTS)
tts_components.description: Generic HTTP TTS base class for custom endpoint TTS. Supports configurable URL templates.

tts_components.name: VitsVoiceProvider (Local TTS)
tts_components.description: Local TTS via VITS/Piper ONNX Runtime inference. Runs entirely on-device.

tts_components.name: AccessibilityVoiceProvider (TTS)
tts_components.description: SimpleVoiceProvider using Android system Accessibility services for basic TTS

tts_components.name: QueuedTtsPlayback
tts_components.description: Queue-based TTS playback manager for sequential message speaking

tts_components.name: VoiceListFetcher
tts_components.description: Fetches available voice lists from cloud TTS providers

speech_services_preferences.description: Unified preferences for STT and TTS service type selection, endpoint URLs, API keys, model names, voice IDs, locale tags

details: Operit v1.12.0 has a full-featured voice system spanning both STT (Speech-to-Text) and TTS (Text-to-Speech). For STT there are 2 cloud providers (Deepgram, OpenAI) and 2 local engines (sherpa-ncnn, sherpa-mnn). The system includes custom wake word enrollment via DTW matching, VAD-based auto-stop detection (Silero ONNX), and pre-recording buffers. For TTS there are 8 service types including a real-time WebSocket provider (OpenAI Realtime), multiple cloud Chinese providers, a generic HTTP provider, and a local VITS ONNX provider for offline TTS. Voice features are controlled via SpeechServicesPreferences.
